conclusion.summary: The accepted wizard packet is implementation-ready at the ledger-intent level: enough concrete flow, copy, states, routing, owner boundaries, constraints, and validation hooks exist to compile into Plans without another product-discovery round. It is not directly code-ready until compiled into canonical Plans and owner-doc PlanUnits.

objective_review.evidence: Four concrete screens have ids, titles, purposes, body copy, and primary/secondary/tertiary actions.
Setup completion, skip, limited setup state, provider return context, Free Models review, and Planning Wizard entry are specified.
Default copy avoids Settings tour, model jargon, raw provider internals, raw diagnostics, and recommendation/coding-strength language.
Provider row labels and Doctor/Health labels cover Connected, Needs sign-in, Could not connect, Ready, Needs setup, Needs attention, and no false-green readiness.
Proposal anchors to FinalGUISpec, Models_System, Assistant Chat/Teacher, Planning Wizard, and Contracts/Wiring owner hints without moving subsystem semantics into Doctor.
Validation criteria require screen order, paid-provider-before-Free-Models, limited-state skip, Doctor no-false-green, Teacher handoff, and no raw diagnostics in default onboarding.
No canonical PlanUnits, implementation files, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, runtime/build surfaces, command wiring patches, or test fixtures exist yet; compile is the required next layer.

subjective_review.judgment: Yes, I would let this proceed to compile without asking another product-design question.
subjective_review.why: The remaining ambiguity is implementation translation, not user-facing intent. A compiler/plan writer can now place the accepted packet into owner docs, preserve source refs, and turn the design into testable PlanUnits.
subjective_review.confidence_reason: The wizard surface is small and well-scoped; provider auth mechanics, provider list, command IDs, and exact GUI layout are intentionally delegated to existing owner docs and compile-time integration.

non_blocking_compile_translation_items: Choose exact first-run provider row source/order from existing provider/account setup owner docs or provider registry behavior.
Map onboarding actions to concrete UICommand/event names during compile/wiring owner placement.
Turn the copy and states into acceptance fixtures and responsive GUI tests.
Reconcile the two recorded adjacent contradiction risks during explicit compile/audit rather than in chat.
negative_constraints_preserved: Do not treat ledger readiness as permission to compile.
Do not treat ledger readiness as direct code implementation readiness.
Do not write canonical Plans, PMConcept.html, generated governance artifacts, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, runtime/build surfaces, or implementation files in this review turn.
